questions.question: $\int f(x) d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\frac{2 \mathrm{x}+1}{\left(\mathrm{x}^{2}+4\right)(\mathrm{x}-1)}$


ধরি,


$\frac{2 x+1}{\left(x^{2}+4\right)(x-1)} \equiv \frac{A x+B}{\left(x^{2}+4\right)}+\frac{C}{(x-1)}$.


$\Rightarrow(2 x+1)=(A x+B)(x-1)+\cdots C \times\left(x^{2}+4\right)$


(ii) নং $এ x=1$ বসিয়ে,


$\begin{aligned}2+1 & =0+c(1+4) \\\Rightarrow 3 & =5 c \\\Rightarrow C & =\frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}$


এখন (ii) নং থেকে,


$\begin{aligned}& 2 x+1=A x-A x+B x-B+C x^{2}+4 C \\& 2 x+1=x^{2}(A+C)+x(B-A)+4 C-B\end{aligned}$


উভয় পক্ষ্যে সহগ সমীকৃত করে পাই,


$B-A=2$


$A+C=0$ $4 C-B=1$


$A+C=0$


$\Rightarrow A=-C=-\frac{3}{5} \quad \therefore A=-3 / 5$


এবং, $B-A=2$


$\Rightarrow B=2+A$


$=2-\frac{3}{5}$


$=\frac{7}{5}$


A,B,C এড় মান (ii) নং এ বসিয়ে পাই,


$\therefore \frac{2 x+1}{\left(x^{2}+4\right)(9 x-1)}=\frac{\left(\frac{-3}{5} x+\frac{7}{5}\right)}{\left(x^{2}+4\right)}+\frac{\frac{-3}{5}}{(x-1)}$


$=-\frac{1}{5}\left[\frac{(3 x-7)}{2^{2}+4}+\frac{3}{x-1}\right]$


$\therefore \frac{2 x+1}{\left(x^{2}+4\right)(x-1)}=\frac{-1}{5}\left[\int \frac{3 x-7}{x^{2}+4} d x+3 \operatorname{in}(x-1)\right]$


$=\frac{-1}{5} \int\left(\frac{3 x}{x^{2}+4}-\frac{7}{x^{2}+4}\right) d x+3 \ln (x-1)$


$=-\frac{1}{5}\left[\frac{3}{2} \int \frac{2 x}{x^{2}+4} d x-\frac{2 \times 7}{4} \int \frac{1 / 2}{1+\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^{2}} d x\right]+3 \ln (x-1)$


$\left.=\frac{-1}{5}\left[\frac{3}{2} \ln \left(x^{2}+4\right)-\frac{7}{2} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)\right]+3 \ln (x-1)\right]+c$ [बেখানে $\mathrm{c}$ একত্রী যেগাত্রীকরণ ধ্রুবক $]$


$=\frac{-3}{10} \ln \left(x^{2}+4\right)+\frac{7}{10} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)+\frac{3}{5} \ln (x-1)+c$ ans.

questions.question: y = 4g(x) ও y = 2x দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $g(x)=x^2$


এবং $y=4 g(x)$


$\therefore \mathrm{y}=4 \mathrm{x}^2 ............ (i)$


এবং $\mathrm{y}=2 \mathrm{x} ....................... (ii) $


(1) নং সমীকরণে $y=2 x$ বসিয়ে পাই,


$2 x=4 x^2$


বা, $2 x^2-x=0$


বা, $x(2 x-1)=0$


$\therefore \quad \mathrm{x}=0, \mathrm{x}=\frac{1}{2}$


$\mathrm{x}=0$ হলে (2)নং হতে পাই, $\mathrm{y}=0$


$\mathrm{x}=\frac{1}{2}$ হলে (2)নং হতে পাই, $\mathrm{y}=1$


$\therefore \quad$ (1)নং পরাবৃত্ত ও (2)নং রেখা পরস্পর $\mathrm{O}(0,0)$ এবং $\mathrm{B}\left(\frac{1}{2}, 1\right)$ বিন্দুতে ছেদ করে।


$\therefore$ (1)নং ও (2)নং দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল


$\begin{aligned}& =\int_0^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\mathrm{y}_1-\mathrm{y}_2\right) \mathrm{dx}=\int_0^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(2 \mathrm{x}-4 \mathrm{x}^2\right) \mathrm{dx} \\ & =2 \int_0^{\frac{1}{2}} \mathrm{xdx}-4 \int_0^{\frac{1}{2}} \mathrm{x}^2 \mathrm{dx} \\ & =2\left[\frac{\mathrm{x}^2}{2}\right]_0^1 \frac{1}{2}-4\left[\frac{\mathrm{x}^3}{3}\right]_0^{\frac{1}{2}}=\frac{2}{2}\left(\frac{1}{2^2}-0\right)-\frac{4}{3}\left(\frac{1}{2^3}-0\right) \\ & =\frac{1}{4}-\frac{4}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{8}=\frac{1}{4}-\frac{1}{6}=\frac{3-2}{12}=\frac{1}{12} \text { বর্গ একক }\end{aligned}$


নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $\frac{1}{12}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: $\int \ln x^{3} d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int \ln x^{3} d x$


$=3 \int \ln x d x$


$=3\left[\ln x \int d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x} \ln x \int d x\right\} d x\right]$


$=3\left[\mathrm{x} \ln \mathrm{x}-\int \frac{1}{\mathrm{x}} \cdot \mathrm{x} \cdot \mathrm{dx}\right]$


$=3\left[x \ln x-\int d x\right]=3 x \ln x-3 x+c$


$\therefore \ln \int \mathrm{x}^{3} \mathrm{dx}=3 \mathrm{x} \ln \mathrm{x}-3 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{c}$.

questions.question: যোগজ নির্ণয় কর : $\int \frac{d x}{5+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\tan \mathrm{x}$


প্রদত্ত রাশি, $=\int \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{5+\mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{x}\right)}$


$=\int \frac{d x}{5+\tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)}$


$=\int \frac{d x}{5+\cot x}$


$=\int \frac{1}{5+\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}} d x=\int \frac{\sin x}{5 \sin x+\cos x} d x$


ধরি, $\sin x=m(5 \sin x+\cos x)+n \frac{d}{d x}(5 \sin x+\cos x)$


$=5 m \sin x+m \cos x+n(5 \cos x-\sin x)$


$=5 m \sin x+m \cos x+5 n \cos x-n \sin x$


$\therefore \sin \mathrm{x}=(5 \mathrm{~m}-\mathrm{n}) \sin \mathrm{x}+(\mathrm{m}+5 \mathrm{n}) \cos \mathrm{x}$


উভয়পক্ষ হতে $\sin x$ ও cosx এর সহগ সমীকৃত করে পাই,


$5 m-n=1 ...... (i) $


$m+5 n=0 ....... (ii) $


এখন, (i) $\times 5 \Rightarrow 25 \mathrm{~m}-5 \mathrm{n}=5$


$\underline{\quad (ii) \times 1 \Rightarrow m+5 n=0}$


$\quad$ (+) করে, $26 m=5$


বা, $m=\frac{5}{26}$


(ii)নং এ $\mathrm{m}$ এর মান বসিয়ে পাই,


$\frac{5}{26}+5 n=0$


বা, $5 \mathrm{n}=-\frac{5}{26}$


$\therefore \mathrm{n}=-\frac{1}{26}$


$\therefore \int \frac{\sin x}{5 \sin x+\cos x} d x=\int \frac{\frac{5}{26}(5 \sin x+\cos x)-\frac{1}{26}(5 \cos x-\sin x)}{5 \sin x+\cos x} d x$


$=\frac{5}{26} \int d x-\frac{1}{26} \int \frac{5 \cos x-\sin x}{5 \sin x+\cos x} d x$


$=\frac{5}{26} x-\frac{1}{26} \ln |5 \sin x+\cos x|+c$


নির্ণেয় যোগজ : $\frac{5}{26} \mathrm{x}-\frac{1}{26} \ln |5 \sin \mathrm{x}+\cos \mathrm{x}|+\mathrm{c}$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর উপবৃত্ত ও $x-3=0$ সরলরেখা দ্বারা ১ম চতুর্ভাগে আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-২: $9 \mathrm{x}^{2}+25 \mathrm{y}^{2}=225$


বা, $\frac{x^{2}}{25}+\frac{y^{2}}{9}=1$


বা, $\frac{\dot{y}^{2}}{9}=1-\frac{x^{2}}{25}$


বা, $y^{2}=\frac{9}{25}\left(25-x^{2}\right)$


বা, $y=\frac{3}{5} \sqrt{25-x^{2}}$


এবং $\mathrm{x}-3=0$


বা, $x=3$


$\therefore$ আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল


$\begin{aligned} & =\int_3^5 \mathrm{dx} \\ & =\int_3^5 \frac{3}{5} \sqrt{25-x^2} \mathrm{dx} \\ & =\frac{3}{5} \int_{\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}} \sqrt{25-25 \sin ^2 \theta \cdot 5} \cos \theta \mathrm{d} \theta \\ & =3 \int_{\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}}^5 5 \sqrt{1-\sin ^2 \theta \cdot \cos \theta \mathrm{d} \theta} \\ & =15 \int_{\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta \int_{\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 2 \cos ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & =\frac{15}{2} \int_{\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta \\ & =\frac{15}{2}\left[\theta+\frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_{\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & \therefore \sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4 \\ & \sin ^{-1} \theta=\frac{3}{5} \\ & \therefore \cos ^{-1} \theta=\frac{4}{5}\end{aligned}$

$=\frac{15}{2}\left[\theta+\frac{2 \sin \theta \cdot \cos \theta}{2}\right]_{\sin ^{-1 \frac{3}{5}}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}$


$=\frac{15}{2}\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\sin \frac{\pi}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\pi}{2}\right)-\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}+\frac{3}{5} \cdot \frac{4}{5}\right)\right]$


$=\frac{15}{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+0-\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}-\frac{12}{25}\right)$


$=\frac{15}{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}-\frac{12}{25}\right)$ বর্গ একক


নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $\frac{15}{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\sin ^{-1} \frac{3}{5}-\frac{12}{25}\right)$ বর্গ একক।়

questions.question: $\int\{\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x})\}^{2} \mathbf{d x}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}$

 

$\therefore \int\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}^{2} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int(\sin x-\cos x)^{2} d x$

 

$=\int\left(\sin ^{2} \mathrm{x}+\cos ^{2} \mathrm{x}-2 \sin \mathrm{x} \cdot \cos \mathrm{x}\right) \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int(1-\sin 2 \mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int \mathrm{dx}-\int \sin 2 \mathrm{xdx}=\mathrm{x}+\frac{\cos 2 \mathrm{x}}{2}+\mathrm{c}$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $x+\frac{\cos 2 x}{2}+c$.

questions.question: $\int \frac{1-f(x)}{1+f(x)} d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}$

 

ধরি, $\mathrm{I}=\int \frac{1-\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}{1+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$\begin{aligned}& =\int \frac{1-(\sin x-\cos x)}{1+(\sin x-\cos x)} d x \\& =\int \frac{1-\sin x+\cos x}{1+\sin x-\cos x} d x\end{aligned}$

 

এখন, $1-\sin x+\cos x=l(1+\sin x-\cos x)+m \frac{d}{d x}(1+\sin x-\cos x)+n$

 

$=l(1+\sin x-\cos x)+m(\cos x+\sin x)+n.......... (i)$.

 

$=(1+n)+(1+m) \sin x+(-1+m) \cos x$.

 

উভয়পক্ষ হতে $\sin x, \cos x$ ও ধ্রুব পদ সমীকৃত করে পাই,

 

$1+n=1........... (ii)$

 

$1+m=-1.......... (iii)$

 

$-1+m=1$ ........... (iv)

 

এখন, (iii) + (iv) হতে, $2 \mathrm{~m}=0 \Rightarrow \mathrm{m}=0$

 

$\mathrm{m}=0$ হলে, (iii) হতে, $1=-1$

 

$1=-1$ হলে, (ii) হতে, $\mathrm{n}=2$

 

(i) নং হতে পাই,

 

$\begin{aligned}& I-\sin \mathrm{x}+\cos \mathrm{x}=-1(1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x})+0+2 \\& \therefore I=\int \frac{-1(1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x})+2}{1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx} \\& =-\int \mathrm{dx}+2 \int \frac{1}{1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx} \\& =-\mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{I}_{1}\end{aligned}$

 

যেখানে, $\mathrm{I}_{1}=\int \frac{1}{1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int \frac{1}{1+\frac{2 \tan \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}-\frac{1-\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}} d x$

 

$=\int \frac{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}+2 \tan \frac{x}{2}-1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}} d x$

 

$=\int \frac{\sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{2 \tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}+2 \tan \frac{x}{2}} d x$

 

$=\int \frac{2 d y}{2 y^{2}+2 y}$

 

ধরি, $\tan \frac{x}{2}=y$

 

বা, $\frac{1}{2} \sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2} d x=d y$

 

বা, $\sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2} d x=2 d y$

 

$=\int \frac{1}{\mathrm{y}(\mathrm{y}+1)} \mathrm{dy}=\int\left(\frac{1}{\mathrm{y}}-\frac{1}{\mathrm{y}+1}\right) \mathrm{dy}$

 

$=\ln \mathrm{y}-\ln (\mathrm{y}+1)+\mathrm{c}$

 

$=\ln \frac{y}{y+1}+c=\ln \frac{\tan \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{x}{2}}+c$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{I}=-\mathrm{x}+2 \ln \frac{\tan \frac{\mathrm{x}}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{\mathrm{x}}{2}}+\mathrm{c}$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $-x+2 \ln \frac{\tan \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{x}{2}}+c$.

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর, $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \mathrm{~g}(\cos \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta=\frac{3 \pi}{32}+\frac{1}{4}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^{4}$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{g}(\cos \theta)=\cos ^{4} \theta$

 

এখন, $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} g(\cos \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \cos ^{4} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(2 \cos ^{2} \theta\right)^{2} \mathrm{~d} \theta=\frac{1}{4} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(1+\cos 2 \theta)^{2} \mathrm{~d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(1+2 \cos 2 \theta+\cos ^{2} 2 \theta\right) \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\theta+2 \frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_{0}^{-\frac{\pi}{4}}+\frac{1}{4.2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 2 \cos ^{2} 2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\sin \frac{\pi}{2}\right)-0\right]+\frac{1}{8} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(1+\cos 4 \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{\pi}{16}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{8}\left[\theta+\frac{\sin 4 \theta}{4}\right]_{0}^{-\frac{\pi}{4}}$

 

$=\frac{\pi}{16}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{8}\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\sin \pi}{4}\right)-0\right]$

 

$=\frac{\pi}{16}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{\pi}{32}+0=\frac{3 \pi}{32}+\frac{1}{4}$

 

$\therefore \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \mathrm{~g}(\cos \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta=\frac{3 \pi}{32}+\frac{1}{4}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $\int \frac{5 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{4 \mathrm{x}}} \mathrm{dx}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int \frac{5 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{4 \mathrm{x}}} \mathrm{dx} $

 

$=\int \frac{5 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}}{1+\left(\mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}\right)^{2}} \mathrm{dx} $

 

ধরি, $\mathrm{y}=\mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}$

 

বা, $\mathrm{dy}=2 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx} $

 

$=\frac{5}{2} \int \frac{2 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}}{1+\left(\mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}\right)^{2}}=\frac{5}{2} \int \frac{\mathrm{dy}}{1+\mathrm{y}^{2}}=\frac{5}{2}, \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{y}+\mathrm{c}=\frac{5}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}+\mathrm{c}$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $\frac{5}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}+\mathrm{c}$.

questions.question: $\int\left[\frac{1+\{f(x)\}^{2}}{1+f(x)}+\frac{1}{f(x)+\sqrt{f(x)}+1}\right] d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^{2}$

 

$\therefore \int\left[\frac{1+\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}^{2}}{1+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\sqrt{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}+1}\right] \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int\left[\frac{1+\mathrm{x}^{4}}{1+\mathrm{x}^{2}}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{x}+1}\right] \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int \frac{x^{2}\left(1+x^{2}\right)+1-x^{2}}{1+x^{2}} d x+\int \frac{1}{x^{2}+2 \cdot x \cdot \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4}+1-\frac{1}{4}} d x$

 

$=\int x^{2} d x+\int \frac{1-x^{2}}{1+x^{2}} d x+\int \frac{1}{\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2}+\frac{3}{4}} d x$

 

$=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+\int \frac{-\left(1+x^{2}\right)+2}{1+x^{2}} d x+\int \frac{1}{\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^{2}} d x$

 

$=\frac{x^{3}}{3}-\int 1 d x+2 \int \frac{1}{1+x^{2}} d x+\frac{1}{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}} \tan ^{-1} \frac{x+\frac{1}{2}}{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}$

 

$=\frac{x^{3}}{3}-x+2 \tan ^{-1} x+\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{2 x+1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)+c$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $\frac{x^{3}}{3}-x+2 \tan ^{-1} x+\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{2 x+1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)+c$.

questions.question: $\int_{1}^{2}\left[\sqrt{f(x)} e^{f(x)}+\frac{\{f(x)-1\}^{2}}{f(x)}\right] d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^{2}$

 

$\begin{aligned} \mid & \therefore \int_1^2\left[\sqrt{f(x)} e^{f(x)}+\frac{f(x)-1\}^2}{f(x)}\right] d x=\int_1^2\left[\sqrt{x^2} e^{x^2}+\frac{\left(x^2-1\right)^2}{x^2}\right] d x \\ & =\int_1^2 \mathrm{x} e^{x^2} d x+\int_1^2 \frac{x^4-2 x^2+1}{x^2} d x \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \int_1^2 2 x e^{x^2} d x+\int_1^2\left(x^2-2+x^{-2}\right) d x \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \int_1^2 e^{x^2} \mathrm{~d}\left(x^2\right)+\left[\frac{x^3}{3}-2 x+\frac{x^{-2+1}}{-2+1}\right]_1^2=\frac{1}{2}\left[e^{x^2}\right]_1^2+\left[\frac{x^3}{3}-2 x-\frac{1}{x}\right]_1^2 \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e^1\right)+\left(\frac{8}{3}-4-\frac{1}{2}\right)-\left(\frac{1}{3}-2-1\right) \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{16-24-3}{6}-\frac{1-9}{3} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{-11}{6}+\frac{8}{3}=\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{8}{3}-\frac{11}{6} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{16-11}{6} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{5}{6}\end{aligned}$

 

নির্ণেয় মান : $\frac{1}{2}\left(e^{4}-e\right)+\frac{5}{6}$.

questions.question: $\int \sqrt{1-\sin 2 x} d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int \sqrt{1-\sin 2 x} d x$

 

$=\int \sqrt{\sin ^{2} x+\cos ^{2} x-2 \sin x \cos x} d x$

 

$=\int \sqrt{(\cos x-\sin x)^{2}} d x$

 

$=\int(\cos x-\sin x) d x$

 

$=\sin \mathrm{x}+\cos \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{c}$

questions.question: $\int x \boldsymbol{h}(x) d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\mathrm{h}(\theta)=\tan ^{-1} \theta$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{h}(\mathrm{x})=\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}$

 

প্রশ্নমতে, $\int x h(x) d x=\int x \tan ^{-1} x d x$

 

$=\tan ^{-1} x \int x d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x}\left(\tan ^{-1} x\right) \int x d x\right\} d x$

 

$=\tan ^{-1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}-\int \frac{1}{1+x^{2}} \cdot \frac{x^{2}}{2} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\tan ^{-1} \frac{x^{2}}{2}-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{x^{2}}{1+x^{2}} d x$

 

$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{1+x^{2}-1}{1+x^{2}} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}-\frac{1}{2}\left(\mathrm{x}-\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}\right)+\mathrm{c}$

 

$=\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x} x^{2}-\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{x}+\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{c}$

 

$=\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x\left(x^{2}+1\right)-\frac{1}{2} x+c$

questions.question: যোগজীকরনের সাহায্যে উদ্দীপকে প্রদত্ত বৃত্তের প্রথম চর্তুভাগে অবস্থিত অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
বৃত্তের সমীকরণ, $x^{2}+y^{2}=25$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}^{2}=25-\mathrm{x}^{2}$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}= \pm \sqrt{25-x^{2}}$

 

$\mathrm{y}=0$ হলन,

 

$\mathrm{x}= \pm 5$

 

প্রদত্ত বৃত্তের প্রথম চর্তুভাগে অবস্থিত অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল,

 

 

$\begin{aligned} & =\int_0^5 y d x \\ & =\int_0^5 \sqrt{5^2-x^2} \mathrm{dx} \\ & =\left[\frac{x}{2} \sqrt{5^2-x^2}+\frac{5^2}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{5}\right]_0^5 \\ & =0+\frac{5^2}{2} \sin ^{-1}(1)-0-0 \\ & =\frac{25}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} \\ & =\frac{25 \pi}{4} \end{aligned}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: যোগজ নির্ণয় কর: $\int x e^{x^{2}} d x$
questions.answer:
ধরি,

 

$\begin{aligned}& \mathrm{z}=\mathrm{x}^{2} \Rightarrow \frac{d z}{d x}=2 \mathrm{x} \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{dz}=2 \mathrm{x} d \mathrm{dx} \\ & \Rightarrow \frac{d z}{2}=\mathrm{x} d \mathrm{x}\end{aligned}$

 

$\int x e^{x^{2}} d x$

 

$=\int e^{z} \cdot \frac{d z}{2}$

 

$=\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{e}^{\mathrm{z}}+\mathrm{c}$

 

$=\frac{1}{2} e^{x^{2}}+\mathrm{c}$

questions.question: $\int_{o}^{3} \frac{x f(x)}{(1+x)^{2}} d x$ এর মান নির্ণেয় কর।
উদ্দীপকের ছায়াঘেরা অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
উদ্দীপকের পরাবৃত্তের সমীকরণ,

 

$\mathrm{y}^{2}=4 \mathrm{x}-(\mathrm{i})$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}= \pm 2 \sqrt{x}$

 

প্রথম চর্তুভাগে পরাবৃত্তের সমীকরণ,

 

$\mathrm{y}= \pm 2 \sqrt{x}$

 

সরলরেখার সমীকরণ,

 

$y=x-(\text { iii })$

 

(i) ও (iii) হতে,

 

$\mathrm{x}^{2}=4 \mathrm{x}$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}^{2}-4 \mathrm{x}=0$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}(\mathrm{x}-4)=0$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{x}=0,4$

 

ছেদবিন্দুদ্বয়ের ভূজ 0, 4

 

$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল

 

$=\int_{0}^{4}\left(y_{1}-y_{2}\right) d x$

 

$=\int_{0}^{4}(2 \sqrt{x}-x) d x$

 

$=\left[2 \cdot \frac{x^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\frac{3}{2}}-\frac{x^{2}}{2}\right]_{0}^{4}$

 

$=\left[\frac{4}{3} x^{\frac{3}{2}}-\frac{1}{2} x^{2}\right]_{O}^{4}$

 

$=\frac{4}{3} \cdot 4^{\frac{3}{2}}-\frac{1}{2} 4^{2}-o$

 

$=\frac{32}{3}-8$

 

$=\frac{8}{3}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.answer:

questions.question: $\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{f(\mathrm{x})}{8+\{f(\mathrm{x})\}^2} \mathrm{dx}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর ।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,f(x) = cosx


$\begin{aligned} & \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos x}{8+\cos ^2 x} d x \\ = & \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\cos x}{9-\sin ^2 x} d x \\ = & \frac{\pi}{2} \frac{d z}{3^2-z^2} \\ = & {\left[\frac{1}{2.3} \ln \left|\frac{3+z}{3-z}\right|\right] 0 } \\ = & {\left[\frac{1}{6} \ln \left|\frac{3+z}{3-z}\right|\right] 0 } \\ = & \frac{1}{6}(\ln 2-\ln 1) \\ = & \frac{1}{6} \ln 2\end{aligned}$

ধরি,

$\begin{aligned}& z=\sin x \\& d z=\cos x d x\end{aligned}$

questions.question: নির্দিষ্ট যোগজ ব্যবহার করে g(x) = 72 বৃত্তর ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

 

$g(x)=2 x^{2}+2 y^{2}$

 

$g(x)=72$

 

$\therefore 2 x^{2}+2 y^{2}=72$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{y}^{2}=36$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}^{2}=36-\mathrm{x}^{2}$

 

$\Rightarrow y= \pm \sqrt{6^{2}-x^{2}}$

 

$x$ অক্ষের উপরের অংশে $y$ ধনাত্মক।

 

$\therefore \mathrm{y}=\sqrt{6^{2}-\mathrm{x}^{2}}$

 

নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল $=4 \int_{0}^{6} y d x$

 

$\begin{aligned}& =4 \int_{0}^{6} \sqrt{6^{2}-x^{2}} \\& =4\left[\frac{x \sqrt{6^{2}-x^{2}}}{2}+\frac{6^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{6}\right] 0 \\& =4\left(0+\frac{6^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} 1-0-0\right) \\& =4 \cdot \frac{36}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} \\& =36 \end{aligned}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: $\int x \ln 2 x d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int x \ln 2 x d x$

 

$\left.=\ln 2 x \int x d x-\int \frac{d}{d x} \ln (2 x) \int x d x\right\} d x$

 

$=\ln 2 x \cdot \frac{x^{2}}{2}-\int\left\{\frac{1}{2 x} \cdot 2 \cdot \frac{x^{2}}{2}\right\} d x$

 

$=\frac{x^{2} \ln 2 x}{2}-\int \frac{x}{2} d x$

 

$=\frac{x^{2} \ln 2 x}{2}-\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{x^{2}}{2}+C$

 

$=\frac{x^{2} \ln 2 x}{2}-\frac{x^{2}}{4}+C$

questions.question: $\int_{-2}^{2} f(x) d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=x^{2} \sqrt{16-x^{2}}$

 

$\begin{aligned} & \int_{-2}^2 f(x) d x=\int_{-2}^2 x^2 \sqrt{16-x^2} d x \\ = & \int_{-\frac{\pi}{6}} 16 \sin \theta \cdot 4 \sqrt{1-\sin ^2 \theta} 4 \cdot \cos \theta d \theta \\ & \frac{\pi}{6} \\ = & \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}} 256 \sin ^2 \theta \cdot \cos ^2 \theta d \theta\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & =64 \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{6}}(\sin 2 \theta) d \theta \\ = & \frac{64}{2} \int_{\frac{-\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{6}} 2 \sin ^2 \theta d \theta \\ = & 32 \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}(1-\cos 4 \theta) d \theta\end{aligned}$

 

$=32\left[\theta-\frac{\sin 4 \theta}{4}\right]_{\frac{-\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{6}}$

 

$=32\left[\frac{\pi}{6}-\frac{1}{4} \cdot \sin ^{2} \frac{2 \pi}{3}+\frac{\pi}{6}+\frac{1}{4} \sin \left(\frac{-2 \pi}{3}\right)\right]$

 

$=32\left[\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-\frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right]$

 

$=32\left[\frac{\pi}{3}-\frac{2 \sqrt{3}}{8}\right]$

 

$=\frac{32 \pi}{3}-8 \sqrt{3}$

questions.question: g(x) =0 এবং h(x) =0 বক্র রেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর ।
questions.answer:
$g(x)=y^{2}-8 x$

 

$h(x)_{-}=x^{2}-8 y$

 

$g(x)=0$ এবং $h(x)=0$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{y}^{2}-8 \mathrm{x}=0$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}^{2}=8 \mathrm{x}$

 

$\Rightarrow y=2 \sqrt{2} \sqrt{x}$

 

এবং $x^{2}=8 y$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{y}=\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{8}$

 

মনে করি,

 

$\mathrm{y}_{1}=2 \sqrt{2} \sqrt{\mathrm{x}}$

 

$\mathrm{y}_{2}=\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{8}$

 

এখন,

 

$2 \sqrt{2 x}=\frac{x^{2}}{8}$

 

$\Rightarrow 8 x=\frac{x^{4}}{64}$

 

$\Rightarrow 512 x=x^{4}$

 

$\Rightarrow x\left(x^{3}-512\right)=0$

 

$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}=0,8$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{x}=0$ হলে $\mathrm{y}=0$

 

এবং $x=8$ হলে $y=8$

 

পরাবৃত্তদ্বয়ের ছেদবিন্দু $O(0,0)$ এবং $A(8,8)$

 

$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল,

 

$ \int_{0}^{8} \left(y_{1}-y_{2}\right) d x$

 

$=\int_{0}^{8}\left(2 \sqrt{2} \sqrt{x}-\frac{x^{2}}{8}\right) d x$

 

$=2 \sqrt{2} \int_{0}^{8} \sqrt{x} d x-\frac{1}{8} \int x^{2} d x$

 

$=2 \sqrt{2}\left[\frac{x^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\frac{3}{2}}\right] 0-\frac{1}{8}\left[\frac{x^{3}}{3}\right] \begin{aligned} & 8 \\ & 0\end{aligned}$

 

$=\frac{4 \sqrt{2}}{3}\left(8^{\frac{1}{2}}-0\right)-\frac{1}{24}\left(8^{3}-0\right)$

 

$=\frac{4 \sqrt{2}}{3} \times 16 \sqrt{2}-\frac{64}{3}$

 

$=\frac{64}{3}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: সমাকলন কর : $5 \cos \int 4 x \sin 3 x d x$.
questions.answer:
$\int 5 \cos 4 x \cdot \sin 3 x d x$


$=\frac{5}{2} \int 2 \cos 4 x \cdot \sin 3 x d x$


$=\frac{5}{2} \int\{\sin (4 x+3 x)-\sin (4 x-3 x)\} d x$


$=\frac{5}{2} \int(\sin 7 x-\sin x) d x$


$=\frac{5}{2}\left(-\frac{\cos 7 x}{7}+\cos x\right)+c$


$\therefore \int 5 \cos 4 x \sin 3 x d x=\frac{5}{2}\left(-\frac{\cos 7 x}{7}+\cos x\right)+c$

questions.question: যোগজ নির্ণয় কর : $\int f(x) d x$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^{-1} \mathrm{sin}^{-1} \mathrm{x}^{2}$


$\therefore f(\mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}=\int \mathrm{x}^{-1} \mathrm{in}^{-1} \mathrm{x} \mathrm{x}$


$=\sin ^{-1} x^{2} \int x d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x} \sin ^{-1} x^{2} \int x d x\right\} d x$


$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} x^{2}-\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^{4}}} 2 x \cdot \frac{x^{2}}{2} d x$


$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} x^{2}-\int \frac{x^{3}}{\sqrt{1-x^{4}}} d x$


$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} x^{2}+\frac{1}{4} \int \frac{-4 x^{3}}{\sqrt{1-x^{4}}} d x $


$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} x^{2}+\frac{1}{4} \int \frac{d z}{\sqrt{z}}$


$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} x^{2}+\frac{1}{4} \cdot 2 \sqrt{z}+c$


$=\frac{x^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} x^{2}+\frac{1}{4} \cdot \sqrt{1+x^{4}}+c$


নির্ণেয় যোগজ : $\frac{x^{2}}{2} \sin ^{-1} x^{2}+\frac{1}{2} \sqrt{1-x^{4}}+c$.

questions.question: $\int g(x) d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $g(x)=\frac{x^{2}}{x^{2}-4}$


$\begin{aligned}& \therefore \int g(x) d x=\int \frac{x^{2}}{x^{2}-4} d x \\& =\int \frac{\left(x^{2}-4\right)+4}{x^{2}-4} d x \\& =\int\left(1+\frac{4}{x^{2}-4}\right) d x \\& =x+4 \int \frac{1}{x^{2}-4} d x \\& =x+4 \int \frac{1}{x^{2}-2^{2}} d x \\& =x+4 \frac{1}{2 \cdot 2} \ln \left|\frac{x-2}{x+2}\right|+c \\& =x+\ln \left|\frac{x-2}{x+2}\right|+c\end{aligned}$


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $x+\ln \left|\frac{x-2}{x+2}\right|+c$.

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \frac{d x}{1+\cos 2 x}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
$\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} x^{2} P(x) d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $P(x)=\cos x$


$\therefore \int \mathrm{x}^{2} \mathrm{p}(\mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}=\int \mathrm{x}^{2} \cos \mathrm{x} d \mathrm{x}$


$=x^{2} \int \cos x d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x} x^{2} \int \cos x d x\right\} d x$


$=x^{2} \sin x-\int 2 x \sin x d x$


$=x^{2} \sin x-2\left[x \int \sin x d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x} x \int \sin x d x\right\} d x\right]$


$=x^{2} \sin x-2\left[-x \cos x-\int 1(-\cos x) d x\right]$


$=x^{2} \sin x-2[-x \cos x+\sin x]+c$


$=x^{2} \sin x+2 x \cos x-2 \sin x+c$


$\therefore \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{x}^{2} \mathrm{P}(\mathrm{x}) \mathrm{d} \mathrm{x}=\left[x^{2} \sin x+2 x \cos x-2 \sin x\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}$


$=\left(\frac{\pi^{2}}{4} \cdot 1+2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} \cdot 0-2 \cdot 1\right)-(0+0-0)$


$=\frac{\pi^{2}}{4}+0-2$


$=\frac{\pi^{2}}{4}-2$


$=\frac{\pi^{2}-8}{4}$


নির্ণেয় মান : $\frac{\pi^{2}-8}{4}$.

questions.question: উদ্দীপককর উপবৃত্ত এবং $\mathrm{x}=3$ রেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষুদ্রতর অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রদত্ত উপবৃত্তটি, $\frac{x^{2}}{36}+\frac{y^{2}}{25}=1$


বা, $\frac{y^{2}}{25}=1-\frac{x^{2}}{36}$


বা, $y^{2}=\frac{25}{36}\left(36-x^{2}\right)$


বা, $y=\frac{5}{6} \sqrt{36-x^{2}}$


$\therefore$ উপবৃত্ত ও রেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষুদ্রতর অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল


$=2 \int_{3}^{6} y d x$


$=2 \int_{3}^{6} \frac{5}{6} \sqrt{36-x^{2}} d x$


$=\frac{5}{3} \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{36-36 \sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot 6 \cos \theta d \theta$


$=10 \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 6 \cdot \sqrt{1-\sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot \cos \theta d \theta$


$=60 \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos \theta \cdot \cos \theta d \theta$


$=30 \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 2 \cos ^{2} \theta d \theta=30 \int_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta$


$=30\left[\theta+\frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_{\frac{\pi}{6}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}$


$=30\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{\sin \pi}{2}\right)-\left(\frac{\pi}{6}+\frac{\sin \frac{\pi}{3}}{2}\right)\right]$


$=30\left(\frac{\pi}{3}+0-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)$


$=10 \pi-\frac{15 \sqrt{3}}{2}$ বর্গ একক।


নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল : $10 \pi-\frac{15 \sqrt{3}}{2}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\frac{1-\cos x}{1+\cos x}}\right\} $ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রশ্নমতে,


$\begin{aligned} & \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\frac{1-\cos x}{1+\cos x}}\right\} \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\left.\frac{2 \sin ^2 \frac{x}{2}}{2 \cos ^2 \frac{x}{2}}\right\}}\left[\begin{array}{r}\geq 1-\cos 2 x=2 \sin ^2 x \\ 1+\cos 2 x=2 \cos ^2 x\end{array}\right]\right. \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}\right\} \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \left(\tan \frac{x}{2}\right)\right\} \\ & =\frac{1}{\mathrm{~d}}\left(\tan \frac{x}{2}\right) \\ & \tan \frac{x}{2} \mathrm{~d} x\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & =\frac{1}{\tan \frac{x}{2}} \cdot \sec ^2 \frac{x}{2} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) \\ & =\cot \frac{x}{2} \cdot \sec ^2 \frac{x}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\cos _2^{-}}{\sin _2^{\frac{x}{2}}} \cdot \frac{1}{\cos ^2 \frac{x}{2}} \\ & =\frac{1}{2 \sin _2^{\frac{x}{2} \cos ^{\frac{x}{2}}}} \\ & =\frac{1}{\sin 2 \cdot \frac{x}{2}} \quad[\geq 2 \sin x \cos x=\sin 2 x] \\ & =\frac{1}{\sin x}=\operatorname{cosec} x \text { [Ans.] } \\ & \end{aligned}$

questions.question: $ \int \frac{\mathrm{d} \theta}{1+3\left\{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right\}^{2}} $ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
f(x) = sinx


$\begin{aligned}& \therefore f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) \\& =\cos \theta\end{aligned}$


$\therefore \int \frac{d \theta}{1+3\left\{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right\}^{2}}$


$=\int \frac{d \theta}{1+3(\cos \theta)^{2}}$


$=\int \frac{d \theta}{1+3 \cos ^{2} \theta}$


$=\int \frac{\frac{d \theta}{\cos ^{2} \theta}}{\frac{1+3 \cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos ^{2} \theta}}$


$=\int \frac{\frac{1}{\cos ^{2} \theta} d \theta}{\frac{1}{\cos ^{2} \theta}+\frac{3 \cos ^{2}}{\cos ^{2} \theta}}$


$=\int \frac{\sec ^{2} \theta d \theta}{\sec ^{2} \theta+3}$


$=\int \frac{\sec ^{2} \theta d \theta}{1+\tan ^{2} \theta+3}$ [যেহেতু, $\sec ^{2} \theta=1+\tan ^{2} \theta$ ]


ধরি


$\quad \tan \theta=z $


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \theta}(\tan \theta)=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \theta}(z) $


বা, $\sec ^2 \theta=\frac{\mathrm{dz}}{\mathrm{d}} $


$ \therefore \mathrm{d} z=\sec ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$


$\begin{aligned} & =\int \frac{\sec ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta}{\tan ^2 \theta+4} \\ & \therefore \int \frac{\sec ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta}{\tan ^2 \theta+4}=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^2+4} \\ & =\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^2+2^2} \\ & =\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{2^2+z^2} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{z}{2}\right)+\mathrm{c} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\tan \theta}{2}\right)+\mathrm{c} \text { [Ans.] }\end{aligned}$

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left\{1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\right\}^{2}$ $f(x) \mathrm{d} x=\frac{7}{3}$
questions.answer:
এখানে, $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)$


$=\cos X$


$\therefore\left\{1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\right\}^{2} f(x) \mathrm{d} x$


$=(1+\cos x)^{2} \sin x d x$


ধরি, $\cos x=z$


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\cos x)=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\mathrm{z})$


বা, $-\sin x=\frac{\mathrm{dz}}{\mathrm{dx}}$


বা, $-\sin x \mathrm{~d} x=\mathrm{d} z$


$\therefore \sin x \mathrm{~d} x=-\mathrm{d} z$


$=\int_{1}^{0}(1+z)^{2}(-\mathrm{d} z)$


$=-\int_{1}^{0}(1+z)^{2} \mathrm{~d} z$


$=\int_{0}^{1}(1+z)^{2} \mathrm{~d} z$


$=\int_{0}^{1}\left(1+2 z+z^{2}\right) \mathrm{d} z$


$=\int_{0}^{1} 1 \cdot \mathrm{d} z+\int_{0}^{1} 2 z \mathrm{~d} z+\int_{0}^{1} z^{2} \mathrm{~d} z$


$=[z]_{0}^{1}+2\left[\frac{z^{2}}{2}\right] 1+\left[\frac{z^{3}}{3}\right] \begin{aligned} & 1 \\ & 0\end{aligned}$


$=(1-0)+2 \times\left(\frac{1^{2}}{2}-\frac{0^{2}}{2}\right)+\left(\frac{1^{3}}{3}-\frac{0^{3}}{3}\right)$


$=1+2 \times \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{3}$


$=1+1+\frac{1}{3}$


$=\frac{3+3+1}{3}=\frac{7}{3}$


$\therefore\left\{1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\right\}^{2} f(x) \mathrm{d} x=\frac{7}{3} \quad$ [Showed]

questions.question: $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{x}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{x}$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos 2 \cdot \frac{x}{2}}{x}$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 \sin ^{2} \cdot \frac{x}{2}}{x} \quad\left[1-\cos 2 x=2 \sin ^{2} x\right]$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 \sin ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{4 \cdot\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^{2}} \cdot x$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{2\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^{2}} \cdot x$


$=\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{x}{2} \rightarrow \frac{\lim }{}\left(\frac{\sin \frac{x}{2}}{\frac{x}{2}}\right)^{2} \times \lim _{x \rightarrow 0} x$


$=\frac{1}{2} \cdot 1 \cdot 0=0$ (Ans)

questions.question: $\int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{\mathrm{p}(x)}}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$P(x)=4x+3$


$\therefore \int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{\mathrm{P}(x)}}=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{4 x+3}}$


ধরি,


$4 x+3=Z^2 \ldots (i)$


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} z}(4 x+3)=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} z}\left(z^{2}\right)$


বা, $4 \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} z}=2 z$


বা, $4 \mathrm{~d} x=2 z \mathrm{~d} z$


বা, $2 \mathrm{~d} x=z \mathrm{~d} z$


$\therefore \mathrm{d} x=\frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2} \quad \ldots \ldots$... (ii)


এখন, $4 x+3=z^{2}$


বা, $4 x=z^{2}-3$


বা, $2 x=\frac{z^{2}-3}{2}$


বা, $2 x+1=\frac{z^{2}-3}{2}+1$


বা, $2 x+1=\frac{z^{2}-3+2}{2}$


$\therefore 2 x+1=\frac{z^{2}-1}{2} \ldots \ldots \ldots (iii) $


$\therefore \int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{4 x+3}}=\int \frac{\frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2}}{\frac{z^{2}-1}{2} \cdot \sqrt{z^{2}}}$


$=\int \frac{\frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2}}{\frac{\left(z^{2}-1\right) z}{2}}$


$=\int \frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2} \square \frac{2}{z\left(z^{2}-1\right)}$


$=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^{2}-1}$


$=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^{2}-1^{2}}$


$=\frac{1}{2^{\prime} 1} \ln \left|\frac{z-1}{z+1}\right|+\mathrm{c}$


$=\frac{1}{2} \ln \left|\frac{\sqrt{4 x+3}-1}{\sqrt{4 x+3}+1}\right|+c$ [Ans.]

questions.question: ক্যালকুলাসের সাহায্যে 4{Q(x)}2 + 9 {Q(y)}2 = 36 বক্ররেখাটির দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{Q}(x)=x$


এখানে, $\quad 4\{\mathrm{Q}(x)\}^{2}+9\{\mathrm{Q}(y)\}^{2}=36$


বা, $4 x^{2}+9 y^{2}=36 \ldots (1)$


বা, $\frac{4 x^{2}}{36}+\frac{9 y^{2}}{36}=\frac{36}{36}$


বা, $\frac{x^{2}}{9}+\frac{y^{2}}{4}=1$


বা, $\frac{y^{2}}{4}=1-\frac{x^{2}}{9}$


বা, $\frac{y^{2}}{4}=\frac{9-x^{2}}{9} $


বা, $ y^{2}=\frac{4}{9}\left(9-x^{2}\right) $


বা, $ y= \pm \sqrt{\frac{4}{9}\left(9-x^{2}\right)} $


বা, $ y= \pm \frac{2}{3} \sqrt{\left(9-x^{2}\right)} $


$ \therefore y=\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9-x^{2}} $


$ \therefore$ এক-চতুর্থাংশের ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_{0}^{3} y \mathrm{~d} x $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \int_{0}^{3} \sqrt{9-x^{2}} \mathrm{~d} x $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9-(3 \sin \theta)^{2}} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9-9 \sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9\left(1-\sin ^{2} \theta\right)} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


ধরি, $ x=3 \sin \theta $


বা, $ \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} \theta}=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \theta}(3 \sin \theta) $


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} \theta}=3 \cos \theta $


$ \therefore \mathrm{d} x=3 \cos \mathrm{d} \theta $



$ =\frac{2}{3} \cdot 3 \sqrt{1-\sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =2 \cdot 3 \sqrt{\cos ^{2} \theta} \cdot \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =6 \cos \theta \cdot \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =6 \cos ^{2} \theta d \theta $


$ =6 \cdot \frac{1}{2} 2 \cos ^{2} \theta d \theta $


$ =3(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta $


$ =3 \mathrm{~d} \theta+3 \cos 2 \theta d \theta $


$ =3[\theta]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}+3\left[\frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} $


$ =3\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-0\right)+\frac{3}{2}\left(\sin 2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2}-\sin 2.0\right) $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2}+\frac{3}{2}(\sin \pi-\sin 0) $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2}+\frac{3}{2}(0-0) $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2}+0 $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2} $


মোট আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল $=4 \times \mathrm{OAB}$ বর্গ একক


$=4 \times \frac{3}{2} \pi$ বর্গ একক


$=6 \pi$ বর্গ একক (Ans.)

questions.question: $\int \sin ^{11} x \cos x d x নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
ধরি,


$ \sin x=z $


$\Rightarrow  \cos x=\frac{d z}{d x} $


$\Rightarrow  \cos x d x=d z$


$\begin{aligned} & \int \sin ^{11} x \cos x d x \\ & \int z^{11} d z \\ & =\frac{z^{11+1}}{11+1}+c \\ & =\frac{z^{12}}{12}+c \\ & =\frac{1}{12} \sin ^{12} x+c\end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\int \frac{f(x)}{\sqrt{g(x)}} d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=3-2 x$


$g(x)=3+4 x-4 x^2 $


$ \therefore \int \frac{f(x)}{g(x)} d x=\int \frac{3-2 x}{\sqrt{3+4 x-4 x^2}} d x $


$ =\int \frac{\frac{1}{4}(4-8 x)+2}{\sqrt{3+4 x-4 x^2}} d x $


$=\frac{1}{4} \int \frac{4-8 x}{\sqrt{3+4 x-4 x^2}} d x+\int\frac{2}{\sqrt{3+4 x-4 x^2}} dx $


ধরি,


$ z=3+4 x-4 x^2 $


$ \rightarrow \frac{d z}{d x}=(4-8 x) $


$ \rightarrow d z=(4-8 x) d x $


$ =\frac{1}{4} \int \frac{d z}{\sqrt{z}}+\int \frac{2 d x}{\sqrt{4-1+4 x-4 x^2}} $


$ =\frac{1}{4} \cdot 2 \sqrt{z}+\int \frac{2 d x}{\sqrt{4-1+4 x-4 x^2}} $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \sqrt{z}+2 \int \frac{d x}{\sqrt{4-(1-2 x)^2}} $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \sqrt{z}+2 \int \frac{d x}{\sqrt{2^2-(1-2 x)^2}} $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \sqrt{z}+2\left(\sin ^{-1} \frac{1-2 x}{2}\right)-\frac{1}{2}+c $


$ =\frac{1}{2}\left(\sqrt{3+4 x-4 x^2}\right)-\sin ^{-1} \frac{1-2 x}{2}+C $

questions.question: প্রমান কর যে $\int h(x) d x=\frac{x \sqrt{a^2-x^2}}{2}+\frac{a^2}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{a} $
questions.answer:
ধরি,


$ x=a \sin \theta $


$ \Rightarrow  \frac{d x}{d \theta}=a \cos \theta $


$ \Rightarrow  d x=a \cos \theta \cdot d \theta$


$ \int h(x) d x=\int \sqrt{a^2-x^2 d x} $


$ =\int \sqrt{a^2-a^2 \sin ^2 \theta} \cdot a \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =\int \sqrt{a^2\left(1-\sin ^2 \theta\right)} \cdot a \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =\int \sqrt{a^2 \cdot \cos ^2 \theta} \cdot a \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =a^2 \int \cos ^2 \theta d \theta $


$ =a^2 \int \cos ^2 \theta d \theta $


$ =a^2 \int 2 \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cos ^2 \theta d \theta$


$ =\frac{a^2}{2} \int(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta $


$ =\frac{a^2}{2}\left[\theta+\frac{1}{2} \sin ^2 \theta\right] $


$ =\frac{a^2}{2} \theta+\frac{a^2}{2} \sin \theta \cdot \cos \theta+\mathrm{c} $


$ =\frac{a^2}{2} \theta+\frac{a^2}{2} \sin \theta \sqrt{1-\sin ^2 \theta}+\mathrm{c} $


$ =\frac{a^2}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{a}+\frac{a^2}{2} \cdot \frac{x}{a} \sqrt{1-\frac{x^2}{a^2}}+\mathrm{c} $


$ =\frac{x \sqrt{a^2-x^2}}{2}+\frac{a^2}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{a}+\mathrm{c} $


$ \therefore \int h(x) d x=\frac{x \sqrt{a^2-x^2}}{2}+\frac{a^2}{2} \sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{a}+\mathrm{c}$ [Proved]

questions.question: $\int_2^5 \ln 2 x d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int_2^5 \ln 2 x d x $


$ =\left[\ln 2 x \int d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x} \ln 2 x \int d x\right\} d x\right]_2^5 $


$ =\left[x \ln 2 x-\int\left(\frac{1}{2 x} \cdot 2 x\right) d x\right]_2^5 $


$ =[x \ln 2 x-x]_2^5 $


$ =5 \ln 10-5-2 \ln 4+2 $


$ =\ln \frac{10^5}{16}-3 $


$ =\ln \left(2 \times 5^5\right)-3 $


$ =\ln 2+5 \ln 5-3 $

questions.question: $\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} P_1(x) P_2(x) d x$ নির্ণয় কর।দেওয়া আছে, $P_1(x)=x$
questions.answer:
$ P_2(x)=\cot ^{-1} x $


$ \therefore \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} P_1(x) P(x) d x $


$ =\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} x \cot ^{-1} x d x $


$ =\left[\cot ^{-1} x \int x d x-\int\left(\frac{d}{d x}\left(\cot ^{-1} x \int x d x\right) d x\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\right. $


$ =\left[\frac{x^2 \cot ^{-1} x}{2}-\int\left(-\left(\frac{1}{1+x^2}\right) \frac{x^2}{2} d x\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\right. $


$ =\left[\frac{x^2 \cot ^{-1} x}{2}+\int \frac{x^2}{2\left(1+x^2\right)} d x\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} $


$ =\left[\frac{x^2 \cot ^{-1} x}{2}+\int \frac{1+x^2-1}{2\left(1+x^2\right)} d x\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} $


$ =\left[\frac{x^2 \cot ^{-1} x}{2}+\int\left\{\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{2\left(1+x^2\right)}\right\} d x\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} $


$ =\left[\frac{x^2 \cot ^{-1} x}{2}+\frac{x}{2}-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{d x}{1+x^2}\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} $


$ =\left[\frac{x^2 \cot ^{-1} x}{2}+\frac{x}{2}-\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} $


$ =\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)^2\left(\frac{1}{2} \cot ^{-1} \frac{\pi}{4}\right)+\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\pi}{4}-0-0+0 $


$ =\frac{\pi^2}{32} \cot ^{-1} \frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\pi}{8}-\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\pi}{4}$


ইহাই নির্ণেয় মান।

questions.question: নির্দিষ্ট যোগজ ব্যবহার করে চিত্রের ছায়াঘেরা অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রশ্নমতে,


$ x^2+y^2=169 $


$ \rightarrow x^2+y^2=13^2 $


এটি বৃত্তের সমীকরণ, যার কেন্দ্র (0,0) এবং ব্যসার্ধ 13


$ y^2=13^2-x^2 $


$ y=\sqrt{13^2-x^2}$


$\therefore x$ অক্ষের উপরের অংশ $y$ ধনাত্মক।


$\therefore O C A B O$ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল,


$ =2 \times O A B O $ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল,


ধরি,


$ x=13 \sin \theta $


$ \frac{d x}{d \theta}=13 \cos \theta $


$ d x=13 \cos \theta d \theta$


$ =2 \int_0^{13} \sqrt{(13)^2-x^2} d x $


$ 2 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{(13)^2-(13)^2\sin ^2 \theta} \cdot 13 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =169 \int_0^\pi 2 \cos ^2 \theta d \theta $


$ =169 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta $


$ =169\left[\theta+\frac{1}{2} \sin 2 \theta\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} $


$ =169\left[\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{1}{2} \sin 2 \times \frac{\pi}{2}-0-0\right] $


$ =\frac{169}{2} \pi $ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{1} \frac{d x}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
সমাকলন করঃ $\int h(x) d x$
দৃশ্যকল্প-১ : এ উল্লিখিত ছায়াঘেরা অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
$\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin x d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রদত্ত রাশি,


$\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin x d x=[-\cos x]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} $


$ =-\left(\cos \frac{\pi}{2}-\cos 0\right)=-(0-1)=1 $


নির্ণেয় মানঃ 1

questions.question: $x$ এর সাপেক্ষে $f(x)$ এর সমাকলন কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ \quad f(x)=\frac{1}{1+\sin x-\cos x} $


$ \therefore \int f(x) d x=\int \frac{1}{1+\sin x-\cos x} d x $


$ =\int \frac{1}{1+\frac{2 \tan \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}-\frac{1-\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}} d x} $


$ =\int \frac{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{1+2 \tan \frac{x}{2}-1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}} d x $


$ =\int \frac{\sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{2 \tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}+2 \tan \frac{x}{2}} d x $


ধরি,


$ \tan \frac{x}{2}=y $


$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{2} \sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2} d x=d y $


$\Rightarrow \sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2} d x=2 d y $


$ \therefore \int f(x) d x=\int \frac{2 d y}{2 y^{2}+2 y} $


$= \int \frac{1}{y(y+1)} d y $


$= \int\left\{\frac{1}{y(0+1)}+\frac{1}{(y+1)(-1)}\right\} d y $


$ =\int \frac{1}{y} d y-\int \frac{1}{(y+1)} d y $


$ =\int \frac{1}{y} d y-\int \frac{1}{y+1} d y $


$ =\ln |y|-\ln |y+1|+c $


$ =\ln \left|\frac{y}{y+1}\right|+c $


$\therefore \int f(x) d x =\ln \left|\frac{\tan \frac{x}{2}}{\tan \frac{x}{2}+1}\right|+c $

questions.question: 0 থেকে 1 সীমার মধ্যে $\int g(x) d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\begin{aligned}& g(x)=\frac{2+x}{1+x^{2}} \\& \therefore \int_{0}^{1} g(x) d x=\int_{0}^{1} \frac{2+x}{1+x^{2}} d x \\& =\int_{0}^{1} \frac{2}{1+x^{2}} d x+\int_{0}^{1} \frac{x}{1+x^{2}} d x \\& =2 \int_{0}^{1} \frac{1}{1+x^{2}} d x+\frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{1} \frac{2 x}{1+x^{2}} d x \\& =2\left[\tan ^{-1} x\right]_{0}^{1}+\frac{1}{2}\left[\ln \left(1+x^{2}\right)\right]_{0}^{1} \\& {\left[\because \int \frac{f^{\prime}(x)}{f(x)} d x=\ln f(x)+c\right]} \\& =2\left(\tan ^{-1} 1-\tan ^{-1} 0\right)+\frac{1}{2}[\ln 2-\ln 1] \\& =2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-0\right)+\frac{1}{2}(\ln 2-0) \\& =\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{1}{2} \ln 2\end{aligned}$


$\therefore$ নির্ণেয় মানঃ


$\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{1}{2} \ln 2$

questions.question: $\int \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\sqrt{25 \mathrm{x}^{2}-36}}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$ \int \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\sqrt{25 \mathrm{x}^{2}-36}} $


$ = \int \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\sqrt{25\left(\mathrm{x}^{2}-\frac{36}{25}\right)}} $


$ = \frac{1}{5} \int \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\sqrt{\mathrm{x}^{2}-\left(\frac{6}{5}\right)^{2}}} $


$ = \frac{1}{5} \ln \left|\mathrm{x}+\sqrt{\mathrm{x}^{2}-\left(\frac{6}{5}\right)^{2}}\right|+\mathrm{c} $


$ {\left[\because \int \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\sqrt{\mathrm{x}^{2}-\mathrm{a}^{2}}}=\ln \left|\mathrm{x}+\sqrt{\mathrm{x}^{2}-\mathrm{a}^{2}}\right|+\mathrm{c}\right] } $


$ =\frac{1}{5} \ln \left|\mathrm{x}+\frac{\sqrt{25 \mathrm{x}^{2}-36}}{5}\right|+\mathrm{c} $


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল: $\frac{1}{5} \ln \left|x+\frac{\sqrt{25 x^{2}-36}}{5}\right|+c$.

questions.question: $\int f(x) g(x) d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$ \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x} $ এবং $ \mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1) $


$ \therefore \int \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}) \mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}=\int \mathrm{x} \cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1) $


$ =\cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1) \int \mathrm{x} d \mathrm{x}-\int\left\{\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}} \cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1) \int \mathrm{xdx}\right\} \mathrm{dx} $


$ =\cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1) \frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2}- $


$ \int \frac{-1}{1+(\mathrm{x}-1)^{2}} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}}(\mathrm{x}-1) \cdot \frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2} \mathrm{dx} $


$ =\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2} \cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1)+\int \frac{-1}{1+\mathrm{x}^{2}-2 \mathrm{x}+1} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2} \mathrm{dx} $


$ =\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2} \cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1)+\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{\mathrm{x}^{2}-2 \mathrm{x}+2} \mathrm{dx} $


$ =\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2} \cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1)+\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{\left(\mathrm{x}^{2}-2 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{x}\right) 2 \mathrm{x}-2}{\mathrm{x}^{2}-2 \mathrm{x}+2} \mathrm{dx} $


$ =\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2} \cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1)+\frac{1}{2} \int\left(1+\frac{2 \mathrm{x}-2}{\mathrm{x}^{2}-2 \mathrm{x}+2}\right) \mathrm{dx} $


$ =\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{2} \cot ^{-1}(\mathrm{x}-1)+\frac{1}{2^{\mathrm{x}}}+\frac{1}{2} \ln \left|\mathrm{x}^{2}-2 \mathrm{x}+2\right|+\mathrm{c} $


$ {\left[\because \int \frac{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})} \mathrm{dx}=\ln |\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})|\right]} $


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল :


$ =\frac{x^{2}}{2} \cot ^{-1}(x-1)+\frac{1}{2^{x}}+\frac{1}{2} \ln \left|x^{2}-2 x+2\right|+c $

questions.question: $\int \frac{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}{\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})-1\}\left\{\mathrm{f}\left(\mathrm{x}^{2}\right)+1\right\}} \mathrm{dx}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ f(x)=x $


$ \therefore \int \frac{f(x)}{\{f(x)-1\}\left\{f\left(x^{2}\right)+1\right\}} d x $


$ =\int \frac{x}{(x-1)\left(x^{2}+1\right)} d x $


$ =\int \frac{(x-1)+1}{(x-1)\left(x^{2}+1\right)} d x $


$ =\int\left(\frac{1}{x^{2}+1}+\frac{1}{(x-1)\left(x^{2}+1\right)}\right) d x $


$ =\tan ^{-1} x+\int \frac{1}{(x-1)\left(x^{2}+1\right)} d x $


$ =\tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \int\left\{\frac{1}{(x-1)}-\frac{x+1}{x^{2}+1}\right\} d x $


$ =\tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{d x}{x-1}-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{x+1}{x^{2}+1} d x $


$ =\tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \ln |x-1|-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{x+1}{x^{2}+1} d x $


$ =\tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \ln |x-1|-\frac{1}{2} \int \frac{x}{x^{2}+1} d x- \frac{1}{2} \int \frac{1}{x^{2}+1} d x $


$ =\tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \ln |x-1|-\frac{1}{4} \int \frac{2 x}{x^{2}+1} d x- \frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \ln |x-1|-\frac{1}{4} \ln \left|x^{2}+1\right|+c $


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল :


$\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} x+\frac{1}{2} \ln |x-1|-\frac{1}{4} \ln \left|x^{2}+1\right|+c$

questions.question: $\int \ln 7 \mathrm{x} d \mathrm{x}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int \ln 7 x d x$


$=\ln 7 x \int d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x} \ln 7 x \int d x\right\} d x$


$=\mathrm{x} \ln 7 \mathrm{x}-\int \mathrm{dx}=\mathrm{x} \ln 7 \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{c}$


$\therefore \int \ln 7 \mathrm{xdx}=\mathrm{x} \ln 7 \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{c}$

questions.question: $\int_{0}^{8} \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})^{2} \sqrt{64-\mathrm{f}\left(\mathrm{x}^{2}\right)} \mathrm{dx}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{y})=\mathrm{y}$


$\therefore \mathrm{f}\left(\mathrm{x}^{2}\right)=\mathrm{x}^{2}$


প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\int_{0}^{8} f(x)^{2} \sqrt{64-f\left(x^{2}\right)} d x$


ধরি, $\mathrm{x}=8 \sin \theta$


বা, $\mathrm{dx}=8 \cos \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$



$=\int_{0}^{8} \mathrm{x}^{2} \sqrt{64-\mathrm{x}^{2}} \mathrm{dx}$


$=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 64 \sin ^{2} \theta \sqrt{64-646 \sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot 8 \cos \theta d \theta$


$=64.64 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin ^{2} \theta \cdot \sqrt{\cos ^{2} \theta} \cdot \cos \theta d \theta$


$=4096 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin ^{2} \theta \cdot \cos ^{2} \theta d \theta$


$=1024 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 4 \sin ^{2} \theta \cdot \cos ^{2} \theta d \theta$


$=1024 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(2 \sin \theta \cdot \cos \theta)^{2} \mathrm{~d} \theta$


$=1024 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin ^{2} 2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$


$=512 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 2 \sin ^{2} 2 \theta d \theta$


$=512 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1-\cos 4 \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta$


$=512\left[\theta-\frac{\sin 4 \theta}{4}\right]^{\frac{\pi}{2}}$


$=512\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{\sin 2 \pi}{4}\right)-(0-0)\right]$


$=512\left[\frac{\pi}{2}-0-0\right]$


$=256 \pi$


নির্ণেয় মান : $256 \pi$

questions.question: $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y})=0$ দ্বারা $\mathrm{x}$ অক্ষের উপরিভাগে আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y})=\mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{y}^{2}-225$


এখন, $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y})=0$


বা, $x^{2}+y^{2}-225=0$


ধরি $\mathrm{x}=15 \sin \theta$


বা, $d x=15 \cos \theta d \theta$



বা, $x^{2}+y^{2}=225$


বা, $x^{2}+y^{2}=(15)^{2}$


বা, $\mathrm{y}^{2}=(15)^{2}-\mathrm{x}^{2}$


বা, $y=\sqrt{(15)^{2}-x^{2}}$


আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল $=2 \int_{0}^{15} \mathrm{ydx}$


$=2 \int_{0}^{15} \sqrt{(15)^{2}-x^{2}} d x$


$=2 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{(15)^{2}-(15)^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot 15 \cos \theta d \theta$


$=30.15 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{1-\sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot \cos \theta d \theta$


$=450 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos \theta \cdot \cos \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$


$=225 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 2 \cos ^{2} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$


$=225 \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\cos 2 \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta$


$=225\left[\theta+\frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}$


$=225\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{\sin \pi}{2}\right)-\left(0+\frac{0}{2}\right)\right]$


$=225\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+0-0\right)$


$=\frac{225 \pi}{2}$ বর্গ একক


নির্ণেয় আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রগফল $\frac{225 \pi}{2}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: সমাকলন কর: $\int \frac{d x}{4 f\left(\cos ^{-1} x^2\right)+9}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\cos x$


প্রদত্ত রাশি


$ =\int \frac{d x}{4 f\left(\cos ^{-1} x^2\right)+9} $


$ =\int \frac{d x}{4 \cos \left(\cos ^{-1} x^2\right)+9} $


$ =\int \frac{d x}{4 x^2+9}=\int \frac{1}{4\left(x^2+\frac{9}{4}\right)} d x=\frac{1}{4} \int \frac{1}{x^2+\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^2} d x $


$ =\frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{1}{\frac{3}{2}} \tan ^{-1} \frac{2}{3}+c=\frac{2}{12} \tan ^{-1} \frac{2 x}{3}+c=\frac{1}{6} \tan ^{-1} \frac{2 x}{3}+c $


নির্ণেয় সমাকলিত ফল $\frac{1}{6} \tan ^{-1} \frac{2 x}{3}+c$.

questions.question: $\int_1^3 \frac{1}{x} \sqrt{1-\{f(\ln x)\}^2} d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
$g(x, y)=225$ উপবৃত্ত দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $g(x, y)=9 x^2+25 y^2$ আবার $g(x, y)=225$


বা, $9 x^2+25 y^2=225$


বা, $25 y^2=225-9 x^2$


বা, $25 y^2=9\left(25-x^2\right)$


বা, $y^2=\frac{9}{25}\left(25-x^2\right)$


বা, $y=\frac{3}{5} \sqrt{25-x^2}$

উপবৃত্তটি দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রফল


$ =4 \int_0^5 y d x $


$ =4 \int_0^5 \frac{3}{5} \sqrt{25-x^2} d x $


$ =\frac{12}{5} \int_0^5 \sqrt{25-x^2} d x $


$ =\frac{12}{5} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{25-25 \sin ^2 \theta \cdot} \cdot \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =12 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 5 \sqrt{1-\sin ^2 \theta \cdot \cos \theta d \theta} $


$ =60 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos ^2 \theta d \theta $


$ =30 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta $


$ =30\left[\theta+\frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} $


$ =30\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\frac{\sin \pi}{2}\right)-(0+0)\right] $


$ =15 \pi $ বর্গ একক


নির্ণেয় উপবৃত্ত দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল 15 $\pi$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: $\int x \ln x^2 d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$ \int x \operatorname{In} x^2 d x $


$ =\operatorname{In} x^2 \int x d x-\int\left\{\frac{d}{d x} \operatorname{In} x^2 \int x d x\right\} d x $


$ =\frac{x^2}{2} \operatorname{In} x^2-\int \frac{1}{x^2} \cdot 2 x \cdot \frac{x^2}{2} d x=\frac{x^2}{2} \operatorname{In} x^2-\int x d x $


$ =\frac{x^2}{2} \operatorname{In} x^2-\frac{x^2}{2}+c=\frac{x^2}{2}\left(\operatorname{In} x^2-1\right)+c. $


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল $\frac{x^2}{2}\left(\operatorname{In} x^2-1\right)+c$.

questions.question: $\int f(x) d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $ f(x)=\frac{1}{x^2(x-1)}$


প্রদত্ত রাশি $ =\int f(x) d x $


$ =\int \frac{1}{x^2(x-1)} d x=\int \frac{1}{x}\left\{\frac{1}{x(x-1)}\right\} d x $


$ =\int \frac{1}{x}\left\{\frac{1}{x-1}+\frac{1}{x(-1)}\right\} d x $


$ =\int \frac{1}{x}\left\{\frac{1}{x-1}-\frac{1}{x}\right\} d x=\int \frac{1}{x(x-1)} d x-\int \frac{1}{x^2} d x $


$ =\int\left(\frac{1}{x-1}-\frac{1}{x}\right) d x-\int x^{-2} d x $


$ =\operatorname{In}|x-1|-\operatorname{In}|x|-\frac{x^{-2+1}}{-2+1}+c $


$ =\operatorname{In}|x-1|-\operatorname{In}|x|+\frac{1}{x}+c $


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল $=\operatorname{In}|x-1|-\operatorname{In}|x|+\frac{1}{x}+c$

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের পরাবৃত্ত ও সরলরেখা দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $y^2=6 x ......... (i)$


এবং $y=x ..... (ii) $


(1) নং এ $y=x$ বসিয়ে


$x^2=6 x$


বা, $x^2-6 x=0$


বা, $x(x-6)=0$


$\therefore x=0, x=6$


এখানে, $y_1^2=6 x$ এবং $y_2=x$


বা, $y_1= \pm \sqrt{6 x}$ এবং $x$ - অক্ষের


উপরে $y_1$ ধনাত্মক।


আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_j^6\left(y_1-y_2\right) d x$


$ =\int_0^6(\sqrt{6 x}-x) d x $


$ =\int_0^6(\sqrt{6} \cdot \sqrt{x}-x) d x $


$ =\int_0^6\left(\sqrt{6} \cdot x^{\frac{1}{2}}-x\right) d x $


$ =\left[\sqrt{6} \cdot \frac{x^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\frac{3}{2}}-\frac{x^2}{2}\right]_0^6 $


$ =\left(\frac{2 \sqrt{6}}{3} \cdot 6^{\frac{3}{2}}-\frac{36}{2}\right)-0 $


$ =\frac{2 \sqrt{6}}{3} \cdot 6 \sqrt{6}-18 $


$ =24-18=6 $ বর্গ একক।


নির্ণেয় আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল 6 বর্গ একক।

questions.question: $\int_1^2 x^3 e^{x^4} d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
$\int\left\{\frac{f(x)}{g(x) h(x)}+\sqrt[3]{x}\right\} d x$ নির্ণয কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=x+1, g(x)=x-1$ এবং $h(x)=x^2+9$


প্রদত্ত রাশি $ =\int\left\{\frac{f(x)}{g(x) h(x)}+\sqrt[3]{x}\right\} $


$ =\int\left\{\frac{x+1}{(x-1)\left(x^2+9\right)}+\sqrt[3]{x}\right\} d x $


$ =\int \frac{(x-1)+2}{(x-1)\left(x^2+9\right)} d x+\int \mathrm{x}^{\frac{1}{3}} \mathrm{dx} $


$ =\int \frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^2+9} \mathrm{dx}+2 \int \frac{1}{(\mathrm{x}-1)\left(\mathrm{x}^2+9\right)} \mathrm{dx}+\frac{\mathrm{x}^{\frac{1}{3}+1}}{\frac{1}{3}+1} $


$ =\frac{1}{3} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{x}}{3}+2 \frac{1}{10} \int\left\{\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}-1}-\frac{\mathrm{x}+1}{\mathrm{x}^2+9}\right\} \mathrm{dx}+\frac{3}{4} \mathrm{x}^{\frac{4}{3}} $


$ =\frac{1}{3} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{x}}{3}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |\mathrm{x}-1|-\frac{1}{5} \int\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}}{\mathrm{x}^2+9}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^2+9}\right) \mathrm{dx}+\frac{3}{4} \mathrm{x}^{\frac{4}{3}} $


$ =\frac{1}{3} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{x}}{3}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |\mathrm{x}-1|-\frac{1}{5 \cdot 2} \ln \left|\mathrm{x}^2+9\right|-\frac{1}{5 \cdot 3} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{x}}{3}+\frac{3}{4} \mathrm{x}^{\frac{4}{3}}+\mathrm{c} $


$ =\frac{4}{15} \tan ^{-1} \frac{\mathrm{x}}{3}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |\mathrm{x}-1|-\frac{1}{10} \ln \left|\mathrm{x}^2+9\right|+\frac{3}{4} \mathrm{x}^{\frac{4}{3}}+c $

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল $\frac{4}{15} \tan ^{-1} \frac{x}{3}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |x-1|-\frac{1}{10} \ln \left|x^2+9\right|+\frac{3}{4} x^{\frac{4}{3}}+c$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এ উল্লিখিত ফাংশনটি দ্বারা x অক্ষের সাথে আবদ্ধ একটি চাপের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{y}=\cos \mathrm{x}$


একটি চাপ দ্বারা x-অক্ষের সাথে আবদ্ধ অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল


$ =2 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \mathrm{ydx}=2 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos \mathrm{x} d \mathrm{x} $


$ =2[\sin \mathrm{x}]_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} $


$ =2\left[\sin \frac{\pi}{2}-\sin 0\right] $


$ =2(1-0)=2 $ বর্গ একক

 

নির্ণেয় আবদ্ধ চাপের ক্ষেত্রফল 2 বর্গ একক

questions.question: $\int \frac{1}{1+\cos 4 x} d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int \frac{1}{1+\cos 4 x} d x=\int \frac{1}{2 \cos ^2 2 x} d x$


$=\frac{1}{2} \int \sec ^2 2 x d x=\frac{1}{2} \frac{\tan 2 x}{2}+c=\frac{1}{4} \tan 2 x+c$


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল $\frac{1}{4} \tan 2 x+c$.

questions.question: (i) এর বর্ণিত বৃত্তের $x$ অক্ষের উপরের অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল সমাকলন পদ্ধতিতে নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $x^2+y^2=36 ...... (i) $


বা, $y^2=36-x^2$


বা, $y=\sqrt{36-x^2}$

$\qquad \qquad $


আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল $ =2 \int_0^6 y d x $


$ =2 \int_0^6 \sqrt{36-x^2} d x $


$\left\{\begin{matrix} x=6 \sin \theta \\ d x=6 \cos \theta d \theta\end{matrix}\right.$


$ =2 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sqrt{36-36 \sin ^2 \theta} \cdot 6 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =2 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 6 \cdot 6 \sqrt{1-\sin ^2 \theta} \cdot \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =72 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \cos ^2 \theta d \theta $


$ =36 \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta $


$ =36\left[\theta+\frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}=36[\theta+\sin \theta \cdot \cos \theta]_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} $


$ =36\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+0\right)-(0+0)\right]=18 \pi $ বর্গ একক


নির্ণেয় $x$ অক্ষের উপরের অংশের ক্ষেত্রফল $18 \pi$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: $\int \frac{f(y)+1}{f(y) g(y)} d y$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(y)=y-1$


এবং $ g(y)=y^2+4 $


প্রদত্ত রাশি $ =\int \frac{f(y)+1}{f(y) g(y)} d y=\int \frac{y-1+1}{(y-1)\left(y^2+4\right)} d y $


$ =\int \frac{y}{(y-1)\left(y^2+4\right)} d y=\int \frac{(y-1)+1}{(y-1)\left(y^2+4\right)} d y $


$ =\int \frac{1}{y^2+4} d y+\int \frac{1}{(y-1)\left(y^2+4\right)} d y $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+\frac{1}{5} \int\left\{\frac{1}{y-1}-\frac{y+1}{y^2+4}\right\} d y $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |y-1|-\frac{1}{5} \int\left(\frac{y}{y^2+4}+\frac{1}{y^2+4}\right) d y$


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |y-1|-\frac{1}{2.5} \ln \left|y^2+4\right|-\frac{1}{5.2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+c $


$ =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |y-1|-\frac{1}{10} \ln \left|y^2+4\right|-\frac{1}{10} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+c $


$ =\left(\frac{1}{2}-\frac{1}{10}\right) \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |y-1|-\frac{1}{10} \ln \left|y^2+4\right|+c $


$ =\frac{2}{5} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |y-1|-\frac{1}{10}\ln \left|y^2+4\right|+c$


নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল $=\frac{2}{5} \tan ^{-1} \frac{y}{2}+\frac{1}{5} \ln |y-1|-\frac{1}{10} \ln \left|y^2+4\right|+c$

questions.question: $\int\left(\cot ^2 7 x+\sec ^2 9 x\right) d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$ \int\left(\cot ^2 7 x+\sec ^2 9 x\right) d x $


$ =\int\left\{\left(\operatorname{cosec}^2 7 x-1\right)+\sec ^2 9 x\right\} d x $


$ =\int \operatorname{cosec}^2 7 x d x+\int \sec ^2 9 x d x-\int d x $
